items.desc: bright red crab with two big claws, top view

items.desc: whole pepperoni pizza with melted cheese, top view

items.desc: yellow American school bus, three-quarter view
items.note: The yellow was picked in 1939 so drivers spot it in the dim early morning

items.desc: red cooked lobster with two big claws and long antennae, side view
items.note: Lobsters taste with hairs on their legs

items.desc: magnifying glass with a round glass lens in a brass rim and a wooden handle
items.names: magnifying glass, magnifier, hand lens, loupe
items.note: A water drop on a leaf works as a tiny magnifier

items.desc: chrome adjustable wrench, top view
items.names: wrench, spanner, adjustable wrench, adjustable spanner, monkey wrench
items.note: An adjustable wrench is called a "shifter" in Australia

items.desc: large soft brown pretzel in the classic twisted knot shape, sprinkled with coarse salt
items.note: The twist was said to look like arms folded in prayer

items.desc: pair of fluffy pink house slippers
items.note: Cinderella's slipper may first have been fur, not glass

items.desc: white bowling pin with two red stripes around the neck
items.note: A bowling pin is made of maple wood under its white coat

items.desc: red wooden canoe with pointed ends and a paddle resting across it, side view
items.note: The oldest known boat in the world is a dugout canoe

items.desc: wooden cello standing upright on its spike, with its bow
items.note: A cello is played sitting down, held between the knees

items.desc: purple sea urchin, a round shell covered in long spines
items.note: Its mouth is underneath, with five teeth called Aristotle's lantern

items.desc: silver five-armed candelabra holding lit white candles

items.desc: badminton shuttlecock with white feathers and a round cork base

items.desc: hermit crab poking out of a spiral seashell, orange legs and claws

items.desc: Caribbean steel drum, a shiny silver pan with dimpled note areas on top, and two rubber-tipped sticks
items.names: steel drum, steel pan, steelpan, pan, ?drum

items.desc: round woven bamboo steamer basket, stacked two high with a lid, holding dumplings
items.names: bamboo steamer, steamer, steamer basket, dim sum basket

items.desc: wooden slide rule, long ruler with a sliding middle strip and a clear cursor

items.desc: yellow aluminium spirit level with three small liquid vials showing a bubble

items.desc: bunch of lychees with bumpy red skin, one peeled showing white flesh

items.desc: terracotta Moroccan tagine pot with a tall cone-shaped lid, painted patterns

items.desc: colourful three-wheeled auto rickshaw tuk-tuk with a canopy roof
items.names: tuk-tuk, tuk tuk, auto rickshaw, rickshaw, autorickshaw

items.desc: antique wooden handheld stereoscope viewer with two lenses and a double photo card in the holder

items.desc: purple kohlrabi, a round bulb with a few leaf stalks sprouting from the top

items.desc: horseshoe crab, a brown domed shell with a long spiky tail, top view

items.desc: antique brass astrolabe, a disc with a pierced star map plate, a rotating pointer and a ring at the top
items.note: An astrolabe could tell the time from the height of a star

items.desc: Arab dhow sailing ship with a wooden hull and large triangular lateen sails

items.desc: wooden kendama toy, a handle with cups on a cross-piece, a spike on top and a red ball tied on a string
items.note: The aim is to land the ball in the cups or on the spike

items.desc: steel handpan, a flying-saucer-shaped instrument with a central dome and dimpled note areas around it
